principles: Do not mutate the old workspace during rebuild except for explicit OpenClaw runtime updates.
Product backend owns authoritative session and memory state.
OpenClaw accesses product state through backend APIs.
Migrate by runnable slices, not by broad rewrites.

phases.name: backup_and_cockpit
phases.goal: Freeze the old workspace, create the new repo, and write cockpit/contracts.

phases.name: minimal_backend_session_shell
phases.goal: Create a runnable backend that supports health, food directions, session start/swipe/view.

storage.reason: P1 validates API compatibility and card flow without taking on persistence risk. Store abstraction should allow JSON or SQLite later.

validation: GET /api/food-directions returns at least one card with image_url and direction_id
POST /api/session/start returns a session with stage=direction and current_cards
invalid session id returns ok=false error.code=session_not_found

phases.name: ark_direction_summary
phases.goal: Add Ark/Doubao provider and migrate direction summary to low-latency API calls with local fallback.

phases.name: offer_cards_and_finalize
phases.goal: Migrate offer card generation and final recommendation while preserving API contracts.

phases.name: memory_authority
phases.goal: Migrate memory CRUD and candidate confirmation as backend-owned authoritative state.

phases.name: openclaw_bridge
phases.goal: Expose explicit APIs for OpenClaw skills to read context and submit job results or memory candidates.

phases.name: miniapp_modularization
phases.goal: Move mini program code from one large page file into API, asset, session-flow, card-swipe, Xiaowang, and memory modules.
